hash_method: Python hashlib SHA256 over exact UTF-8 source bytes; Git SHA1 over b"blob "+decimal byte length+b"\0"+bytes; compared with connector blob and assigned tree when present.
inspection_note: Line selections are retrieval/read locations, not a claim of exhaustive file review. Some early combined outputs were truncated; L1 claims and decisive excerpts identify the bounded content relied on. Original connector payload and full exact source bytes are retained.
unsuccessful_lookup_note: One extra lookup of apps/desktop/src/renderer/i18n/pt.ts returned an error. That path is not in the assigned population; the actual locale index imports br.ts. Its error response is retained without fabricating source bytes.
